messages:
Miriam: quick sync — noticed saved views behave inconsistently across routes when users in different timezones open them. e.g., a per-route filter `last 24h` shows different absolute ranges depending on viewer timezone.

Alex: ah yeah. that's because saved views currently store relative ranges + client applies timezone. we originally did that to keep views 'local' to each user.

Jia: is the ask here to make saved views timezone-agnostic (UTC) or to add an explicit timezone flag in the view meta?

Miriam: leaning toward explicit timezone in the saved view metadata. two benefits: reproducible analytics snapshots and easier shareability across teams.

Dan: +1 for explicit flag. also want to call out quota/telemetry implications — if teams pin a UTC-based view and everyone runs the same heavy query on schedule, we could see blast of tokens/compute. need rate limit / caching guardrails.

Evan: can we add a per-saved-view throttle setting? like `max_runs_per_hour` or fallback to cached results for N minutes when > X users request same view.

Jia: technical note: backend stores savedview as: {scope, filters, owner, sharing}. we can add `time_origin: {type: "local"|"utc"|"fixed" , tz: "America/NY"}`. sample: ```
{
  "scope":"route:payment-checkout",
  "filters":["status:200","latency>50ms"],
  "time_origin":{"type":"fixed","tz":"UTC","range":"2025-03-02T00:00:00Z/2025-03-03T00:00:00Z"}
}
```

Miriam: that looks good. UX question: where to expose `time_origin`? route default? when saving a view offer: "Use my local timezone" / "Use route timezone (account)" / "Set fixed timezone".

Alex: and add a warning if view has wide range + high cardinality filters, suggest enabling cached snapshot or schedule with incremental buckets. small inline cost estimate would help.

Dan: Can ops add a soft quota per-team for savedview query cost? e.g., monthly cost budget for scheduled savedviews, with email warning and an auto-disable threshold.

Evan: From infra side, we can add a dedup cache key: hash(filters + time_origin + route + time_bucket). If many requests hit same key within Xs, serve cached. fallback to queue for batch compute.

product-bot: deploy-note: scheduled snapshots feature branch `feature/savedview-snapshots` created by @Jia (PR #4287). CI passed.

Miriam: next steps: Jia to prototype backend shape + cache key, Alex to mock UX copy and cost estimate chip, Dan to propose quota thresholds & alerting, Evan to validate cache strategy and fallback queue. sync tomorrow 10am PT.

Alex: tiny UX ask — saved views list should show "time origin" column and a small flame/cost icon when view is cost-heavy. hover shows estimated monthly cost.

Jia: noted. I'll add a `cost_estimate` float in metadata (nullable) populated by telemetry job.

Dan: for sharing semantics: team-shared views run under team's quota, personal views under user's team (or personal?) — we need clear rules. add to doc.

Miriam: yes. draft policy: shared->team quota, organization-shared->org quota, personal->team quota by default (but can mark as personal-billed). We'll draft policy doc after prototype.

Evan: also consider telemetry sampling rate when computing cost_estimate. use 1% sample and extrapolate, plus a safety multiplier.

Miriam: perfect. saving notes in product board. thanks all :thumbsup:
